findings.evidence: Observed 180 sessions (37 weekly blocks); annualized gross Sharpe is -1.64 with 90% bootstrap CI [-3.25, 0.50] crossing zero.
findings.why_it_matters: A bootstrap confidence interval that crosses zero indicates the observed positive return is within 1-sigma noise of a flat or losing strategy.
findings.next_experiment: Decompose returns by market regime (`gym.label_regimes`) and test whether a single drawdown cluster or noisy entry filter is diluting the signal.
findings.limitation: Bootstrap resampling preserves marginal distribution but does not test structural regime breaks.

findings.finding: Pessimistic Execution Cost & Slippage Stress Survival
findings.evidence: Mean gross edge is 7.79 bps/trade, which is consumed by 1.0x pessimistic round-trip costs of 15.00 bps/trade -> net -7.21 bps/trade (breakeven cost multiplier: 0.52x; annualized cost drag: 735.0 bps; net Sharpe: -2.07).
findings.why_it_matters: Strategies whose gross edge per trade is smaller than realistic spread + slippage + adverse selection bleed capital deterministically in live execution.
findings.next_experiment: Increase minimum holding horizon or signal conviction threshold to raise gross edge per trade above 22.5 bps, or reduce turnover via a wider no-trade buffer (`warden.plan_rebalance`).
findings.limitation: Assumes static per-trade bps friction; flash-crash tail slippage can exceed 2.0x normal assumptions.

findings.evidence: Max drawdown reached 23.74% (worst 5-session loss: -13.33%; calm-regime mean: 1.35 bps/day vs high-vol mean: -28.04 bps/day).
findings.why_it_matters: Drawdowns exceeding 25% or sharp 5-day crashes trigger risk-engine halts and force liquidation at the bottom.
findings.next_experiment: Apply ATR-scaled position sizing (`warden.explain_sizing`) and halve exposure on overnight gaps > 1.2x ATR.
findings.limitation: Evaluates close-to-close equity; intraday excursion can exceed close-to-close drawdown.

findings.finding: Trade Outlier Concentration & House Position Cap Compliance
findings.evidence: Top-5 trades account for 93.2% of positive gross PnL across 35 trades; max single-position weight reached 38.0% of equity (5 trade(s) breached the 25% house cap).
findings.why_it_matters: Backtests driven by a handful of oversized outlier trades fail in production when the live risk gate (`warden.validate_order`) clamps single-name exposure at 25% of equity.
findings.next_experiment: Re-run the backtest with hard pre-trade position clamping (`max_position_pct <= 0.25`, `max_gross_exposure_pct <= 0.60`) and winsorize top-5 trades to verify edge persists.
findings.limitation: Evaluates per-trade size; full intraday portfolio overlap requires timestamped position snapshots.

findings.evidence: Detected 1 timestamp lookahead leak(s) ['earnings_flag (available_at=2026-10-18T16:00:00Z > as_of=2026-10-15T20:00:00Z)'] and 1 banned actuals source(s) ["weather_hdd_shock (source='open-meteo.archive')"].
findings.why_it_matters: Features computed from timestamps after `as_of` or from archive actuals (rather than point-in-time vintage releases) inject future knowledge into historical decisions and invalidate the backtest.
findings.next_experiment: Lag offending features to their public filing/release timestamp (`available_at <= as_of`) and replace archive actuals with point-in-time vintage series (`warden.audit_features`).
findings.limitation: Audits declared manifest metadata; does not parse arbitrary Python/C# feature-engineering code.

findings.evidence: No benchmark return series (`benchmark_path` or `benchmark_rows`) was supplied.
findings.why_it_matters: Without a benchmark series, passive beta exposure cannot be separated from active alpha.
findings.next_experiment: Supply a benchmark CSV/Parquet (e.g. SPY or equal-weight universe) to compute active Information Ratio.
findings.limitation: Absolute Sharpe can be inflated by secular bull-market drift.

findings.evidence: Tabular artifact audit only — strategy source code and discarded trial count were not evaluated locally.
findings.why_it_matters: Even a clean return series and manifest cannot prove that 500 parameter combinations were not swept behind the scenes to find one lucky backtest.
